write_up: At Cedar Creek High School, you teach Algebra II and AP Statistics and have turned a functions unit into an online module. A recruiter can see the classroom work quickly. The learning design direction is newer, and the resume gives it less room.

The Canvas module is your best model: it names the unit, the format and the tool you used. Your teaching line also gives a recruiter a useful picture of your classes. The professional learning community line leaves more to the imagination.

Start with what you do with the math department’s professional learning community. If learning design is the direction you want next, give the Canvas module and any other portfolio work more room, including what you built and what happened when people used it.
